name: unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> Box < [T] , A >
rule: Before calling `assume_init`, the caller must ensure that every element of the boxed slice is fully initialized as a valid value of type `T`; calling it with content that is not fully initialized causes immediate undefined behavior.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::boxed::Box < [mem::MaybeUninit < T >] , A > { unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> alloc::boxed::Box < [T] , A > }
